family.name: Grenadier
family.verdict: A billionaire couldn't buy the old Defender, so he built his own from a pub table, a BMW engine and a pair of tractor axles. It is gloriously square, genuinely capable and steers like a canal boat (until 2026).
intro: When Land Rover ended classic Defender production at Solihull in January 2016 after 67 years, chemicals billionaire Sir Jim Ratcliffe tried to keep it alive. Jaguar Land Rover said no. So Ratcliffe did what billionaires do: he founded a car company, Ineos Automotive, and named its first product after his favourite pub, The Grenadier in Belgravia, where the idea was first kicked around.

The result is a body-on-frame, beam-axle, permanent-4WD box built in a former Smart car factory in Hambach, France. BMW supplies the straight-six engines (B58 petrol, B57 diesel), ZF the eight-speed automatic, Tremec the two-speed transfer case and Italian tractor specialist Carraro the solid axles. Magna Steyr helped with the engineering.

The Station Wagon arrived in late 2022, with US deliveries (petrol only) beginning for the 2024 model year. The Quartermaster double-cab pickup followed into production in late 2023 and reached US buyers for 2025. Both are new enough that the owner knowledge base is still being written, mostly on forums and in recall notices.

page.title: Ineos Grenadier Station Wagon
page.verdict: The old Defender's spirit with a BMW heart and Italian tractor axles. Huge capability, real quirks, and steering that only got properly sorted for 2026.

paragraphs: In January 2016 Land Rover stopped building the [[land-rover/defender-90-110|classic Defender]] after 67 years, and Sir Jim Ratcliffe, the chemicals magnate behind Ineos, took it personally. He approached Jaguar Land Rover about buying the tooling to keep it in production, and JLR declined. So Ratcliffe built a replacement himself and named it after his favourite pub, The Grenadier in Belgravia, where the idea was hatched. Most pub ideas end with a hangover. This one ended with a factory.

story.heading: A PUB, A GRUDGE AND A CLEAN SHEET
paragraphs: Ineos announced Ineos Automotive in February 2017 to do the job, and the work ran under the codename Projekt Grenadier. Toby Ecuyer led design, and the brief was unapologetically utilitarian: a box-section steel ladder frame, solid axles at both ends and a shape that looks like it was drawn with a ruler because, functionally, it was. The finished exterior was shown online on 1 July 2020, and nobody needed the press release to see which old Land Rover it was mourning.

Land Rover had tried to trademark the old Defender's shape, and Ineos opposed the applications. The UK Intellectual Property Office refused registration for lack of distinctiveness, and in August 2020 the High Court dismissed JLR's appeal. That cleared the legal road for a square, upright, flat-glassed 4x4 built by somebody else. Ineos had argued the shape didn't work as a 'badge of origin' for JLR, and the courts agreed.

story.heading: BMW HEART, TRACTOR AXLES, FRENCH ADDRESS
paragraphs: Ineos wasn't going to design an engine from scratch. In March 2019 it signed BMW for powertrains: the 3.0-litre B58 turbo petrol six (282 hp, 332 lb-ft) and the B57 diesel six (245 hp, 406 lb-ft), both through a ZF eight-speed automatic and a Tremec two-speed transfer case with a 2.5:1 low range. Magna Steyr in Austria came on as engineering partner in December 2019, and the program logged a claimed 1.1 million miles of testing, including an outback hot-weather session in early 2022 that got interrupted by a flood.

The axles come from Carraro, an Italian tractor specialist, hung on five-link coil suspension with Eibach springs. Assembly was first planned for a new plant in Bridgend, Wales, announced in September 2019. Then Mercedes put its Smart factory in Hambach, France, up for sale, and in December 2020 Ineos bought it, along with a recently upgraded paint shop and a workforce that had been building Smarts since 1998. The steel floor and shell get 4,068 spot welds, and the body meets the frame in an eight-bolt drop.

story.heading: WHAT YOU ACTUALLY GET
paragraphs: Specs read like an overlander's wish list: 264 mm of ground clearance, 800 mm wading depth, 3,500 kg (about 7,700 lb) braked towing, permanent four-wheel drive with a lockable centre diff, and front and rear lockers via the Rough Pack, standard on the Trialmaster. Inside, the diff locks and off-road switches live in an aircraft-style overhead panel, there's a low-volume 'toot' horn for cyclists, and the rotary controller is BMW iDrive in work boots.

The catch is the steering. Up to the 2025 model year the Grenadier uses a Bosch hydraulically assisted recirculating-ball box with almost four turns lock to lock, and testers complained about vagueness and wander on the road. Ineos redid it for 2026 with a new variable-ratio worm gear, more assist as you turn, and a hydraulic stop at full lock. If the [[g-class/g500|G 500]] is the boxy 4x4 that went to the opera, the Grenadier is the one that stayed behind to fix the fence, and the 2026 truck finally does it without a workout.

story.heading: SO FAR, SO SQUARE
paragraphs: Series production began at Hambach in late 2022, with first deliveries that December. US buyers got the petrol B58 only, from $71,500, with US-spec trucks leaving France in September 2023. Then the growing pains. NHTSA recalls covered auxiliary-switch wiring that could short (a fire risk), steering ball-joint nuts that needed to be locking ones, and door buttons short on grease that could let a door open on the move. In September 2024 a parts shortage linked to the insolvency of supplier Recaro Automotive stopped the line until January 2025.

Production figures cited on Wikipedia put output at 4,553 Grenadiers in 2023 and about 8,000 in 2024, well short of the 25,000 a year Ineos said the plant could build at full capacity. The Quartermaster pickup joined in late 2023. Owners on the forums report software and electrical gremlins alongside real affection for the thing. It is the closest thing on sale to a new [[land-rover/defender-90-110|classic Defender]] with a warranty, and it has the quirks to prove it.

callout.label: SIDEBAR · THE COURTROOM
callout.title: Land Rover v. a Shape
paragraphs: Before the Grenadier turned a wheel, it won a court case. Jaguar Land Rover applied to trademark the old Defender's shape, and Ineos, which was building a car with a very similar shape, opposed the applications.

The UK Intellectual Property Office refused registration because the shape lacked distinctiveness. Ineos argued it didn't act as a 'badge of origin' for JLR. JLR appealed, and in August 2020 the High Court dismissed the appeal. A box, it turns out, belongs to everyone.

page.engineering_intro: The Grenadier is old-school where it counts and bought-in where that's smarter. A box-section steel ladder frame carries Carraro beam axles on five-link coils, with permanent 4WD through a Tremec two-speed transfer case. The body is welded at Hambach and bolted to the frame in an eight-bolt drop. The engines and gearboxes are bought in from BMW and ZF. The frame, axles and body are Ineos' own.

buying_checks.head: Run the VIN for all three US recalls
buying_checks.body: 23V828 (auxiliary switch relay wire trapped under a fastener, fire risk), 23V903 (non-locking nuts on the steering rod ball joint) and 25V147 (door button assemblies short on grease; 7,022 trucks built July 6, 2023 to April 19, 2024). All are free dealer fixes. Ask for proof they were done.

buying_checks.head: Ask about software and module history
buying_checks.body: Forum owners report fuel 'implausibility' warnings that took more than one reflash, false steering warnings, failed modules and unexplained messages. A truck with documented updates and a quiet dash is worth more than one with a thin service file.

buying_checks.head: Drive it on a real road
buying_checks.body: Pre-2026 trucks use the slow Bosch recirculating-ball box that reviewers called vague and wandering. Some owners love it, some fit aftermarket stabilizers or pump kits. MY2026 got a new variable-ratio steering gear. Know which one you're buying.

buying_checks.head: Check for water in the doors and cabin
buying_checks.body: Owners have reported rear doors holding water after a wash, condensation, door seals coming off and a kickplate whose adhesive let go. Look at door bottoms, carpets and seals.

buying_checks.head: Check the oil level and the break-in service
buying_checks.body: One owner got a low-oil message at 12,000 miles. Many owners did an early break-in oil change (500–1,000 miles was the dealer advice quoted on the forum). Ask whether it was done and check the dipstick reading in the menu.

buying_checks.head: Confirm the Rough Pack if you want lockers
buying_checks.body: The centre diff lock is standard, but front and rear lockers come with the Rough Pack ($2,850 on base and Fieldmaster at launch; standard on Trialmaster). Look for the locker switches in the overhead panel.

buying_checks.head: Inspect any lift and big-tire install
buying_checks.body: Agile Offroad warns that lift height changes can damage the factory driveshaft. On trucks with 285/75s or bigger, check that the spare clears the small rear door, and look for tire rub caused by a body sitting off-center on the frame.

buying_checks.head: Understand the parts and dealer network
buying_checks.body: Ineos is a young brand with a small dealer network, and the factory stopped from September 2024 to January 2025 over a parts shortage. Powertrain parts are BMW and ZF, but body and chassis parts come through Ineos. Ask the local dealer about parts lead times.

repairs.title: Engine oil and filter change (B58)
repairs.cost: About $150 dealer oil service quoted by a US owner; a US first service including transfer case and diff fluids was quoted at about $1,700
repairs.symptoms: Service due, or an 'Engine Oil Low' message. Many owners do an early break-in change, then shorter intervals than the factory schedule.
repairs.fix: Put the hood in its maintenance position and remove the plastic engine cover. The canister filter housing is on top of the engine; an owner used an impact-rated 32 mm socket on it and needed no U-joint. Swap the element and its O-ring, drain the sump, fit a new drain plug washer, refill and check the level in the menu. Tall owners still report standing on a crate to reach the housing.
repairs.tools: 32 mm socket · drain pan · BMW-type oil filter with O-ring and crush washer · oil: an owner quoted the manual as 6.5 L of 0W-20, ACEA C2 / BMW LL-17FE (check your own manual)

parts.name: BMW 0W-20 LL-17FE+ oil change kit for the B58 (7 L Genuine BMW oil + filter, O-ring, drain washer)

repairs.title: Engine air filter
repairs.symptoms: Service interval, or after dusty trail use. One owner changes it every second oil change (about 5,000 miles).
repairs.fix: Loosen the captive screws around the airbox (they don't come out), lift the upper half, remove the old filter and drop in the new one. Note how the white felt pre-filter is fitted: on some it's glued to the filter, on others it clips into the bottom of the box. Reassemble.
repairs.tools: PZ3 (Pozidriv #3) screwdriver · filter (a member says Mahle LX3985/1 matches OEM; not officially confirmed)

parts.name: Mahle LX3985/1 air filter (owner-reported OEM match; not officially confirmed)
Mahle LX3985 BMW air filter (close sibling of LX3985/1; check it matches before buying)

repairs.title: Cabin air filter
repairs.time: ≈ 5–10 minutes once you know the trick
repairs.symptoms: Weak airflow or musty smell. Note: one owner found almost no cabin heat in 15°F weather with the filter removed.
repairs.fix: On a left-hand-drive truck, slide the passenger seat back and recline it, then lie on your back in the footwell with a headlamp. Unsnap the two side clips under the filter frame, let the hinged plate swing down, pull the filter out (a curved pick helps), and fit the new one with the airflow arrow toward the cabin. Snap it shut. The glovebox stays in place.
repairs.tools: Headlamp · curved pick · cardboard to lie on · OEM INEOS #100326881, or Microguard 3692 reported to fit (no charcoal layer); Mann CUK25001 reported not to fit

parts.name: Microguard 3692 cabin air filter (owner-reported fit, no charcoal layer)
OEM INEOS cabin filter #100326881

repairs.title: Spare carrier clearance after upsizing tires
repairs.cost: Washers, or $239 for a relocation bracket
repairs.symptoms: With 285/75R17 or 255/85R17 tires, the spare hits or barely clears the small rear door.
repairs.fix: Owners running 285/75s and 255/85s added a couple of washers under the spare carrier bolts (one used the top and lower-left bolts) to tilt the spare clear of the small door. For bigger tires or a cleaner fix, Leitner Designs sells a bolt-on bracket that moves the spare 1¾ in. up, right and outboard. Leitner rates it for up to 37 in. tires, but not for wheels with more than 25 mm offset.
repairs.tools: Socket set · washers · or Leitner Designs Grenadier tire relocation bracket

parts.name: Grenadier tire relocation bracket
Grenadier tire relocation bracket

repairs.title: Tire rub on one side only: re-center the body on the frame
repairs.symptoms: Bigger tires rub on one side but clear on the other, with the same wheels and offset on both sides.
repairs.fix: On the INEOS Forum, a shop found one truck's body sitting off-center on the chassis. Slackening the body mount bolts, re-centering the body and re-tightening fixed the rub. Measure fender-to-tire gaps on both sides before you blame the tire, and torque the body mounts to factory spec.
repairs.tools: Floor jack · large sockets · torque wrench · factory torque specs

parts.name: Body-mount bolts and hardware (INEOS parts counter)

repairs.title: Door doesn't latch / door button sticks (recall 25V147)
repairs.symptoms: Exterior door button stays pressed in, door doesn't fully latch, or the head unit shows a door-open warning that turns red with chimes once you're moving.
repairs.fix: Ineos found the door button mechanisms on 7,022 US 2024 Grenadiers (built July 6, 2023 to April 19, 2024) may lack grease. Dealers replace the door button assemblies. Until then, check every door is fully shut before driving and take the head unit warning seriously.
repairs.tools: VIN check at nhtsa.gov/recalls · dealer appointment

parts.name: Recall 25V147 door button remedy parts (dealer-supplied, free)

repairs.title: Steering ball-joint nut check (recall 23V903)
repairs.symptoms: Usually none until it's serious. A loose or missing nut can let the steering rod ball joint come apart, and you lose steering.
repairs.fix: Affected 2023–2024 trucks may have non-locking nuts on the steering rod ball joint. Dealers install locking nuts. If you've bought used, confirm the campaign is closed, and check the steering linkage joints after hard trail use as a habit.

parts.name: Recall 23V903 locking ball-joint nut remedy parts (dealer-supplied, free)

repairs.title: Auxiliary switch panel wiring (recall 23V828)
repairs.symptoms: Electrical faults on accessories wired through the auxiliary switch panel relay, or none at all.
repairs.fix: On 2024 trucks with the auxiliary switch package, the relay control wire may be trapped under a fastener, damaging its insulation and risking a short and fire. Dealers inspect and secure the wire, repairing or replacing damaged wiring. Do this before adding lights or fridges to the auxiliary circuits.

parts.name: Recall 23V828 aux switch panel wiring remedy parts (dealer-supplied, free)

faq.q: What's the biggest tire I can fit without a lift?
faq.a: From the factory the Grenadier rides on LT265/70R17 or LT255/70R18 (about 32 in.). INEOS Forum owners report 285/70R17 fits with no problem. 285/75R17 (about 34 in.) is the popular sweet spot: owners report no rub on stock suspension, but you'll probably need a couple of washers under the spare carrier to clear the small rear door. DVA Mechanics' fitment guide lists 295/70R17 as 'stock or 40 mm lift' and treats 35-inch tires (315/70R17) as a 2-inch-lift job. A few forum owners report squeezing 35s onto aftermarket wheels without a lift, but treat 285/75R17 as the practical stock limit.
faq.src: INEOS FORUM · BIG O TIRES · DVA MECHANICS

faq.a: 3,500 kg braked, about 7,700 lb (GearJunkie lists 7,716 lb). That's well above a Wrangler's 2,495 kg in Australian spec. Payload is about 1,680 lb in US figures, so a heavy trailer plus a fully loaded overland build will run into the GVWR before the hitch rating.

faq.q: What fuel economy does it get?
faq.a: Not much. The EPA rates the 2024 petrol Grenadier at 15 mpg city, highway and combined, and the Trialmaster at 14 mpg on premium fuel. The tank holds 90 litres (about 23.8 gal), which gives a range of roughly 350 miles in mixed use at the EPA figure, less with a roof tent and big tires.

faq.q: How much weight can go on the roof?
faq.a: 150 kg (330 lb) dynamic, meaning while driving, and 420 kg (925 lb) static, meaning parked. That's enough for a rooftop tent with people in it. Front Runner's Slimline II kit installs with no drilling and weighs about 57 kg (126 lb) itself, so count it against the dynamic limit.

faq.q: Can I get the diesel in the US?
faq.a: No. In the US and Canada the Grenadier and Quartermaster come only with the BMW B58 3.0 petrol six, 282 hp and 332 lb-ft. The B57 diesel (245 hp, 406 lb-ft) is sold in Europe, Australia and other markets.

faq.q: Does it have lockers, and how does the 4WD work?
faq.a: It has permanent four-wheel drive through a Tremec two-speed transfer case (2.5:1 low), with a centre diff lock on a lever. Front and rear lockers come with the Rough Pack, which also adds BFG KO2 tires. It's standard on the Trialmaster and was a $2,850 option on base and Fieldmaster trucks at US launch. The locker switches are in the overhead panel.

faq.q: What oil does the B58 take and how often should I change it?
faq.a: An owner quoting the manual on the INEOS Forum lists 6.5 L of 0W-20 meeting ACEA C2 / BMW LL-17FE. Check your own manual, since the oil forums note the US manual is vague. One owner reports the manufacturer schedule as every 12,000 miles. Many owners do an early break-in change (500–1,000 miles on dealer advice) and then change it every 5,000–7,500 miles, especially if they tow.

faq.q: Is the steering really that bad?
faq.a: Before 2026, it's slow: a Bosch hydraulic recirculating-ball box with almost four turns lock to lock, which The Drive found wandered on the highway and was heavy when parked. Some owners like it off-road, and Owl sells a $2,150 pump kit and a Fox stabilizer. For MY2026 Ineos fitted a variable-ratio worm gear with more assist and a tighter on-center feel. GearJunkie called it 'a big leap forward'.

faq.q: Which years should I buy or avoid?
faq.a: There's no bad engine to avoid, since every US truck has the B58. The early US trucks (MY2024) carry all three recalls, so get proof they're closed. MY2026 brings the revised steering, HVAC and driver-assist tweaks plus more than 40 smaller changes. If you plan to drive a lot of highway miles, 2026 is the one to buy.

It's too new for a long-term verdict. The BMW six and ZF eight-speed are widely used and well proven elsewhere. Owner reports focus on electronics: modules, false warnings, software reflashes, sticky door buttons and water ingress, plus three US recalls. Most owners on the forums still sound happy, but a good dealer matters more than usual.

faq.q: How capable is it off-road out of the box?
faq.a: Very. It has 264 mm of ground clearance, 800 mm wading depth, and approach, breakover and departure angles of 35.5°, 28.2° and 36.1°, with solid axles and up to three locking diffs. GearJunkie noted there's no disconnecting sway bar, but the soft coils still articulate well.

mods.why: Gives room for 285/75s and up, and restores ride height under bumpers, winches and roof tents. Eibach, the factory spring supplier, makes a Pro-Lift set (about +2.5 in. front, +1.2 in. rear). Watch driveshaft angles.
The pre-2026 steering is the Grenadier's most common complaint. Owners fit pump upgrades and dampers to improve on-road feel.
Tires bigger than about 33 in. crowd the small rear door, wiper and camera. A relocation bracket moves the spare out of the way.
The roof is rated for 150 kg dynamic and 420 kg static, so it's made for a tent. Front Runner's kit installs with no drilling.
There's a factory winch option, but aftermarket bumpers add approach angle, protection and a proper winch mount.
A full-length skid plate protects the transfer case, tank and lines when the Carraro axles are articulating over rocks.

baseline_service.intro: Assume nothing was done early: the factory schedule is long (12 months / 12,000 miles in the US), the full service manual isn't sold to owners, and only dealers can reset the service counter. Baseline every fluid once, keep receipts with OEM-spec fluids to protect the 5-year warranty, and note that much of the drivetrain is shared with BMW (B58/B57 engines, ZF 8-speed), so FCP Euro and other BMW specialists carry many of the consumables.

items.spec: B58 petrol: 0W-20, ACEA C2 (dealers also cite C5 / API SP), BMW Longlife-17 FE+ · 6.5 L per the manual as quoted by owners; buy 7 L. B57 diesel: 0W-30 (the diesel manual lists Petronas Syntium 7000 E 0W-30) · capacity [CONFIRM IN MANUAL]
items.interval: Factory 12 months / 12,000 mi (US); owners and some dealers recommend 5,000–6,000 mi, or 6,000 mi for heavy use
items.note: Hood in maintenance position, engine cover off. 32 mm socket on the canister cap on top of the engine, 17 mm drain plug with a new copper washer, 25 Nm. Owners report the BMW B58 filter fits. Check the level in the menu, not by dipstick.

parts.name: BMW 0W-20 LL-17FE+ oil change kit for the B58 (7 L Genuine BMW oil + filter, O-ring, drain washer)

items.spec: Panel filter with white felt pre-filter (glued on some, clipped into the box on others)
items.interval: Every 2 years / 24,000 mi; much sooner after dusty trails
items.note: Captive PZ3 screws on the airbox. If the history is unknown, just replace it, because it's cheap.

items.spec: ZF Lifeguard 8 ATF · ≈10.6 L reported by an owner [CONFIRM IN MANUAL]
items.interval: Dealer schedule: check every 2 years, replace at 6 years. Owners plan a pan/filter at 40–50k mi.
items.note: Do a drain and pan/filter change (the filter is built into the pan), not a flush. The Grenadier pan has a second, smaller pickup port, so aftermarket aluminium pans may not match. Fill level at the right temperature: use the Offroad › Temperatures screen and keep the truck level.

ZF Lifeguard 8 ATF, 1 L

items.spec: Fuchs Titan Sintopoid 75W-90 (75W-85 also acceptable) · 1.8 L, or 2.64 L if the oil cooler and lines are drained too
items.interval: Dealer schedule: check every 2 years, replace at 6 years. Owners change it much earlier: one found metal flakes at 800 mi, and some trucks had it changed under recall at ~5,000 km.
items.note: O-ring-sealed drain and fill plugs, 15 Nm (owner-reported). Owners quoting the workshop manual say it calls for fill to spill; because the cooler lines drain back, some owners also measure what comes out so they know how much to put back.

parts.name: Fuchs Titan Sintopoid 75W-90, 1 L (buy 3)

items.spec: SAE 80W-90 GL-5 · 2.1 L per axle (workshop-manual figure quoted on the INEOS Forum). Note: Agile Offroad's diff-cover instructions call for 75W-140.
items.interval: First change at 12 months / 12,000 mi, then 60,000 mi per the US schedule as quoted by owners. Owners who wade or tow do it every 10,000 mi.
items.note: Remove the FILL plug first, because owners have snapped fill plugs after draining. 12 mm hex plugs (M22×1.5), 31 Nm; INEOS plug part GRA-5000-021220 (the O-ring isn't sold separately). The fill plug is magnetic. Same fluid with or without the lockers.

parts.name: Fuchs Titan Supergear MC 80W-90 gear oil, 1 L (buy 5)

items.note: If the date is unknown, flush it, especially after water crossings.

items.spec: Penrite LDAS, as cited from an INEOS support document by an Australian owner on the INEOS Forum · [CONFIRM IN MANUAL]
items.interval: Check level and condition at every service
items.note: The recirculating-ball steering is hydraulic. Owners with big tires and heavy steering look at Owl's upgraded pump. Check for leaks at the box and pump.

items.spec: Retorque suspension and body mounts; clear the body and safari-hatch drains
items.interval: At purchase, then every annual service
items.note: Dealer first-service packages include a suspension retorque and drain clearing. Run the VIN for open recalls (door button 25V147, steering ball-joint nut 23V903, aux switch panel 23V828) before anything else.

items.interval: Test at purchase and every service
items.note: Dealers include a battery health test in the annual service. Trucks that sat on a lot often have a tired battery, which causes odd electrical warnings.
